entities.name: church of Saint Anthony Abbot all'Esquilino
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Sant'Antonio abate all’Esquilino is a church in Rome, located near the Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore on via Carlo Alberto in the Esquilino district. It is used by the Russian Greek Catholic Church.
